item.text: The ACT Integrity Commission examined possible corruption in negotiations and advance payments for the Canberra Institute of Technology’s sixth consultancy contract with Redrouge Nominees Pty Ltd.
item.support: focused on whether corrupt conduct occurred in connexion with the negotiations concerning and the payment schedule agreed

item.text: The contract required a third of its price to be paid when it was signed, followed by further payments ahead of the services.
item.support: one third was to be paid on execution of the contract

item.text: The Commission concluded that the then chief executive and an executive director engaged in serious corrupt conduct through the intentional falsification of a key procurement document.
item.support: The integrity of public procurements is a matter of serious public concern and the intentional falsification of a crucial document
